title: Subtopic 1: Introduction to Writing Skills
description: This subtopic introduces the importance of writing skills in various fields, including STEM and experimental research. It covers the basics of effective writing for different audiences and purposes.

title: Subtopic 2: Essential Grammar and Vocabulary
description: Learn the basics of grammar and vocabulary that are essential for clear and effective writing. This includes understanding and using correct tenses, pronouns, and sentence structures.

title: Subtopic 3: Passive Voice and Reported Speech
description: Explore the use of the passive voice and reported speech. Understand when and how to use these structures to convey information more effectively.

title: Subtopic 4: Concord and Cohesive Devices
description: Discover how to use concord and cohesive devices to link ideas and maintain a flow in your writing. This includes coordinating and subordinating conjunctions, and pronouns.

title: Subtopic 5: Signpost Words in Paragraph Writing
description: Learn how to use signpost words to guide readers through your writing. Understand the importance of signposting in maintaining clarity and coherence.

title: Subtopic 6: Technical Writing Basics
description: This subtopic covers the basics of technical writing, including the definition, structure, and types of technical reports. Understand the importance of avoiding plagiarism in technical writing.

title: Subtopic 7: STEM Field-Specific Report Writing
description: Explore how to write effective technical reports in STEM fields. Understand the unique challenges and requirements of writing in these fields.

title: Subtopic 8: Experimental Research Methods
description: Learn about experimental research methods and how to write about them in your reports. Understand the importance of being clear and concise when describing your research methods.

title: Subtopic 9: Plagiarism in Writing
description: Understand what plagiarism is and how to avoid it in your writing. Learn about the importance of citing sources and using quotation marks when necessary.

title: Subtopic 10: Writing for Different Audiences and Purposes
description: This subtopic covers how to write effectively for different audiences and purposes. Understand the importance of tailoring your writing to the reader and the purpose of the report.

title: Subtopic 1: Passive Voice Basics
description: Learn the structure and usage of passive voice in writing. Understand when to use it and how to avoid awkward phrasing.

title: Subtopic 2: Reported Speech: How to Paraphrase Accurately
description: Master the art of reporting speech accurately. Understand the difference between direct and indirect reported speech.

title: Subtopic 3: Concord in Writing
description: Explore the concept of concord and how it affects verb and noun agreement in sentences.

title: Subtopic 4: Signpost Words: Guiding Readers Through Your Writing
description: Discover how signpost words help guide readers through your text, making it more coherent and easier to follow.

title: Subtopic 5: Cohesive Devices: Linking Ideas Together
description: Learn about cohesive devices such as pronouns, conjunctions, and prepositions that help connect ideas and maintain a logical flow in writing.

title: Subtopic 6: Advanced Sentence Structure in Paragraph Writing
description: Enhance your paragraph writing skills by exploring more complex sentence structures and how they contribute to a well-structured paragraph.

title: Subtopic 7: Technical vs. General Writing: Understanding the Differences
description: Distinguish between technical and general writing, and understand the appropriate style and tone for each.

title: Subtopic 8: Project Report Writing: Introduction and Structure
description: Get introduced to the concept of project reports and learn about their structure, including sections like introduction, methods, results, and conclusion.

title: Subtopic 9: Project Report Writing: Purpose and Audience
description: Understand the purpose of a project report and how to tailor your writing to a specific audience, whether it's peers, superiors, or clients.

title: Subtopic 10: Avoiding Plagiarism in Project Reports
description: Learn strategies to avoid plagiarism in your project reports, including proper citation and paraphrasing techniques.
